data.name: Ashish
data.gender_notes: Ashish is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit āśis, 'blessing, benediction'. Its root is Sanskrit āśis (आशिस्). A classical Sanskrit term for a blessing. Ashish is a Sanskrit name meaning “Blessing; benediction”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashish expresses “Blessing; benediction”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashish total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

vedic_reference.note: The name Ashish is derived from the Sanskrit word अशिष (ashisha), which means 'desirelessness' or 'contentment'. It is also the name of the god Ashish, who is said to grant boons to those who are free from all desires.
